cleanRoom.source: Repo-owned Excel/MSForms fixture input generated through public Excel/VBIDE automation and driven with the public Windows clipboard and public user32 SendInput keyboard input.
cleanRoom.prohibited: No Office internals, decompilation, disassembly, non-public source, or OxForms output comparison.

notes: TextBox1 fills the form client area so a single window-centre click focuses it; no screenshot anchor is needed.
Control fonts are intentionally not declared/applied (this is a keyboard event-ordering oracle, not a text-metrics oracle).

The BeforeDropOrPaste handler uses the public MSForms TextBox paste signature with no Index argument; for MultiPage/TabStrip the signature would add a leading Index As Long, but a plain TextBox source interface (MdcTextEvents) does not.

The capture seeds the public Windows clipboard with a repo-owned text value, focuses TextBox1, and sends Ctrl+V via public user32 SendInput (Ctrl down, V down, V up, Ctrl up = 4 inputs). It records the KeyDown/KeyPress/KeyUp keyboard ordering relative to BeforeDropOrPaste and Change.
